game.name: El Shaddai : Ascension of the Metatron (Europe)
game.desc: El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron is an action game for Xbox 360. Its story is based on the apocryphal Book of Enoch and tells the story of Enoch's journey sent by God to hunt down renegade angels. Enoch is guided in his mission by Lucifer, before he himself becomes a fallen angel. The gameplay alternates between combat and platforming sequences, and the title surprises with its original visual approach.
